faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.text: Quick answers to the questions we hear most.

items.question: How do I make an appointment?
items.answer: Send us a message or give us a call. We find a time that suits you, 7 days a week.

items.question: What does a treatment cost?
items.answer: It depends on what is needed. After the examination we explain the options and the cost before we start.

items.question: Does it hurt?
items.answer: Most patients tell us it was painless. We work gently and numb the area when needed.

items.question: Can you save my tooth instead of pulling it?
items.answer: We always try to keep your own teeth. Extraction is the last option, not the first.
